name: Yinglun Yueshan Villa
aiSummary: What are the check-in and check-out times at Yinglun Yueshan Villa?
address: No. 15, Yadanwu Village Group, Laoling Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 這是在莫干山非常獨特的三房民宿，獨門獨院，坐落在莫干山南北二條山脈中間，據説此地正是莫干山洋家樂的發源地，剛好處於裸心堡與祼心谷中間，門前有條清澈的小溪水穿流而過，在感受到山裡獨有的風景同時更帶來涼意，莫干山避暑勝地名副其實，更具象化。 回到正題：二樓是三個房間，面積都不小，在設計與質感山主理人肯定是花了不少心思，房間還是榻榻米的結構，家庭出行也不擔心孩子住不下了，一樓是大廳和廚房，雖房間量少，但這廳的設計完全符合了民宿的標準，如果自己會做飯，廚房還可使用，院子有二個，進門就有一個，未曾相到，穿過客廳還有個後院，這或許就是當下人人嚮往中的山中小院吧 總之，體驗感非常滿意，無其它客人打擾之外，管家不特意安排也在在現場，入住期間，真的有家的感覺，把私密感做到了極致 莫干山避暑選對了！整棟三房不擠不鬧，山風順着溪水吹進院子，住完才知道什麼叫不想走。
comments.author: Cheshou；
comments.quoteEn: A very unusual three bedroom guesthouse, standing on its own between the two ranges at Moganshan. I am told this is where the foreign run guesthouses on this mountain began, and it sits between naked Castle and naked Stables. A clear stream runs past the door, which brings the cool with it along with the view, so the mountain's reputation as somewhere to escape the heat is well earned. To the point: the three bedrooms upstairs are all a good size, and the owner has clearly spent time on the design and the finish. They are tatami, so a family will fit. Downstairs is the hall and the kitchen, and though there are few rooms the hall is exactly what a guesthouse hall should be. You can cook if you want to. There are two courtyards, one at the gate, and a second behind the sitting room that I had not expected, which is probably the mountain courtyard everybody pictures. A thoroughly satisfying stay, with no other guests, and the manager on hand without arranging it. It felt like home, and the privacy is as complete as it gets. The right choice for the summer. Three rooms in one house, no crowding, no noise, and the wind off the stream coming into the courtyard. You only understand not wanting to leave once you have stayed.
